conclusion.reason: Both generation context and assembly support are north/west-only. Existing interior anchors force an east/south closure somewhere, independent of tile ordering. Merely drawing more tiles from northwest can leave old tiles with newly created west/north neighbors they were never constrained against.
conclusion.minimumRecommendedExpansion: Keep the current dimensions and bounded registration method. Add right/bottom support, NE/SW corner support, and reversible row/column wavefront directions. Use the explicit rectangular expansion order below to avoid opposite-side or three-side closure.

currentState.indexFinding: r09_c10/r09_c11/r09_c12 have completePixelCoverage=true but status=missing. Do not enumerate remaining work from status alone; use unique coordinate coverage and validated hashes.

codeLimitations.finding: Mandatory left/top internal dependencies and top-left diagonal; only north/west/NW external contexts. Cannot prepare p14 as NE seed or p41 as SW seed without unavailable predecessor assertions.
Prompt explicitly calls only top/left strips native. Direction-aware prompts must name right/bottom as actual native pixels too.
Ownership mask has left/top half-planes only; seeded halo covers N/W/NW only.
Registration influence distances exist only for left/top, so adding eastCandidate metadata alone cannot constrain east pixels.
Sources are row-major ascending and merged in that order; neighbor loader ignores E/S/NE/SW/SE. Dependency-ready native generation and assembly must use the same orientation.
QA supports actual north/west seams; east/south are always marked no-neighbor and manifest always lists them missing. Neighbor presence, QA and missing-side status must be derived from actual inputs.

concreteExamples.wavefront: NE: start p14, process rows 1..4 and columns 4..1; diagonal parallel levels use (r-1)+(4-c).

concreteExamples.safeOrderContext: In the proposed northward row sweep r08_c11 is also complete, so use S+W and true SW r09_c11.
concreteExamples.wavefront: SW: start p41, process rows 4..1 and columns 1..4; parallel levels use (4-r)+(c-1).
Current NW route remains valid once r09_c14 final pixels and QA are frozen.

coordinateRules.globalPatchXYWH: [(tileColumn-1)*4096-115+(patchColumn-1)*1024, (tileRow-1)*4096-115+(patchRow-1)*1024,1254,1254]; physical pRC identifiers never change with order.
coordinateRules.clippedEastNativeContext: For patch column4: y0=(r-1)*1024-115, lo=max(0,y0), hi=min(4096,y0+1254); crop east [0,lo,115,hi], paste [1139,lo-y0].
coordinateRules.clippedSouthNativeContext: For patch row4: x0=(c-1)*1024-115, lo=max(0,x0), hi=min(4096,x0+1254); crop south [lo,0,hi,115], paste [lo-x0,1139].
coordinateRules.binaryOwnership: Retain ~known OR the intersection of inward half-planes for active directions: left xx>=115, right xx<1139, top yy>=115, bottom yy<1139. Known external pixels stay protected; an absent corner remains unknown, never synthesized by strip extension.
coordinateRules.cornerPriority: True diagonal native overlap overrides the two real same-row/column overlaps at their common corner; true external diagonal fills only the actual outside 115-square. Missing diagonal support must not be invented from N/E or S/W strips.

finiteRegistration.directionalDistance: Use exact discrete reflection of current left/top rules: dLeft=xx-115; dTop=yy-115; dRight=1138-xx; dBottom=1138-yy. Take minimum across active adjacent support directions, then the same smoothstep finite return. For new directions verify this against lossless flipped coordinate-coded arrays to avoid one-pixel errors.
finiteRegistration.doNotIncreaseLimitsToFixTopology: Leaf silhouettes, roof ends, grout branches or other missing structure require AI repair with real neighbor context. Stronger flow/tone cannot create correct structure.
finiteRegistration.protectedAndOutsideInfluence: Known non-owned pixels must equal context exactly; owned pixels where weight=0 must equal native source exactly. Save all ownership/support masks and flow/color arrays for each physical patch.

qaRequirements.internal: All six full4096 seam sheets and corresponding six finite-return sheets at original pixel scale; return lies +256 for positive-direction incoming seams and -256 for reverse incoming seams. Nine internal junction crops.
qaRequirements.external: Generate actual joint edge sheets for every supplied side, not merely no-neighbor strips. Use 160 old +160 new pixels and fold all4096; inspect finite-return line on new tile, and both repair returns if locally repaired. Every missing interior edge remains pending until its neighbor exists.
qaRequirements.fourTileCorners: At each newly completed four-tile junction inspect actual native crops from all four candidate hashes. The proposed order creates exactly224 new complete corners plus1 preexisting corner, totaling225.
qaRequirements.seamLedger: Canonical edge ID is the sorted pair of tile IDs; bind both exact candidate hashes, exact QA crop hash, reviewer and pass status. When either tile changes, invalidate that edge and all affected four-tile junction records. Pixel-identical QA may reuse historical review only with explicit original candidate/QA hashes and pixel reproduction.
qaRequirements.existingCandidateEdges: Seed already contains7 shared edges. Reuse only recorded review evidence matching current hashes or actually inspect; do not forget these because later tiles did not create them.
qaRequirements.outerEdges: The64 map-perimeter tile edges have no in-map neighbor by definition; distinguish intentional world boundary from a still-missing interior neighbor.
qaRequirements.formalAcceptance: Complete coverage and seam ledger do not substitute for navigation or client integration; those statuses remain false until their separate verification.

orderedTraversal.prerequisite: Finish r09_c14 west repair and all7 seed-candidate scoped QA; freeze each dependency SHA before any native child generation. If additional tiles appear concurrently, recompute order against actual known set and do not blindly preserve two-side claims.

alternatives.name: Top-left row-major without helper extensions
alternatives.reason: Starting at r01_c01 eventually creates north/west neighbors of fixed interior seed tiles. Existing seed pixels were not generated against those new neighbors; their shared edges still require explicit joint AI repair and QA. Ordering alone cannot make these seams accepted.

alternatives.name: Lossless canonical flip wrapper
alternatives.details: For NE horizontally reflect all target guides and real context into a canonical NW temporary frame, generate/assemble there, then losslessly reflect final pixels and map physical patch IDs/rectangles back. For SW vertically reflect. This can reuse registration math but still requires orientation-aware provenance, real corner extraction and QA; it is not a zero-change ordering solution. Do not mirror the final world layout or claim original source pixels were natively in the transformed frame.

recommendedValidationBeforeProduction: In-memory coordinate-coded truth arrays for NW/NE/SW and optionalSE: all16 physical cores covered exactly once; native contexts and corner crops equal the same global coordinates.
115-wide clipped E/S exterior contexts map first/last patch lengths1139 and middle1254; no padding or fabricated outside support.
Absent NE/SW remains false in known mask; supplied diagonal remains protected and its115-square reaches correct final-canvas corner.
Reverse wavefront asserts right/bottom native dependencies, uses actual guides at unchanged physical pRC global coordinates, and rejects any wrong-source SHA.
Reflection symmetry of masks and finite weights; explicit tests at core positions115/1138 and zero-return boundary, without raising the max-flow or tone limits.
No side with a real neighbor may be emitted as no-neighbor QA or listed as missing. New reverse external and internal return QA must be checked at1:1.
Verify the explicit249-step sequence covers all256 and480 edges once with true diagonal support; promote seed/repaired pixel hashes before using the sequence.
A first NE pilot r10_c11 and first SW pilot r08_c01 or r08_c12 must pass all actual four-tile and full-edge QA before bulk expansion.
